Title: Azure Machine Learning—Generally available updates for October 2022/Ignite

Body.Content:
New features now generally available include the ability to fully control and customize a model’s training code and efficiently use Python functions to develop your machine learning tasks. 

  1. Generate AutoML model training code: This feature gives you full control and customization of the model’s training code, allowing you to build models quicker and comply with all regulations and policies.
  2. Build and deploy ML models using Azure Machine Learning Python SDK v2: This feature enables you to utilize Python functions to build single and/or complex pipelines and more from simple to complex concepts incrementally.
